craft_notes: Sthāyin: return. Sanskrit-first: command-word kept. Rows: 2. Close: down. Rejected: explaining the lapse — killed: time suffices. Read aloud: falling-rising cadence.

lines: Time frayed it; Śrīkaṇṭha sent it back.
l4.sanskrit_cite: teṣāṃ krameṇa tanmadhye bhraṣṭaṃ kālāntarādyadā | tadā śrīkaṇṭhanāthājñāvaśāt siddhā avātaram
